hook: BAML now compiles to Rust, up to 34x faster.

beats.say: Boundary wrote a new backend for the BAML compiler that turns every BAML program into native Rust code.
On average the compiled code runs about three and a half times faster than their interpreter, and up to thirty-four times faster on tight loops.
BAML reads like TypeScript, is concurrent like Go, has no async keyword, and profiles every function call down to the nanosecond.
